name: researcher-research-synthesize → reviewer-research
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack. Fires when the synthesize-phase researcher terminates with decide(action=emit) — the research category's terminal forward edge. Spawns reviewer-research, which reads the structured research artifact and grades it against the reviewer checklist. Approved terminates the chain (07-reviewer-approved-to-coordinator.json wakes the coordinator for user reply); insufficient triggers 05-reviewer-rejected-retry.json (max_iterations-bounded replan).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.reviewer-research
on_enter.prompt:
The synthesize-phase researcher at loop $entity.instance has emitted a research artifact via emit_research_artifact + decide(action=emit). The rendered markdown is at $entity.triple.research.artifact.path.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance for the synthesize phase's narrative terminal. Then `bash cat $entity.triple.research.artifact.path` to read the full structured artifact. read_loop_result returns only the decide() reason; the structured fields (actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps/test_harness/substrate_mutations/revision) are in the markdown.

Iteration 2 — apply the research-category checklist per reviewer-research/10-evaluation-contract.md. If every required field is present, well-formed, and grounded in the gathered evidence, call decide(action="approved", reason="<one-sentence summary citing the revision token>"). If a required field is missing or evidence is thin, call decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>"); 05-reviewer-rejected-retry.json gates retries (max_iterations=3). Use decide(action="needs_clarification", reason=..., retry_hint=...) only when the artifact's intent is genuinely ambiguous.

metadata.pattern: research category terminal: synthesize-phase researcher emits research artifact → reviewer-research evaluates. Approved wakes coordinator (07); insufficient retries (05).
metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/01a-researcher-synthesize-to-reviewer-research.json — same hand-off shape, no chain.mode or phasevalidator gating.
